ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio characterized by a dominant low-intensity (dark) field with localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters representing approximately 10-15% of the surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous dark-gray/black pixels across the entire fluke surface with high-density distributions of small, white, ring-shaped and circular pixel blobs scattered symmetrically across both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped central depression with an obtuse angle, approximately 130-140 degrees at the vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-to-medium amplitude serrations consisting of irregular peaks and valleys along the entire linear boundary; most pronounced and jagged at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lobed symmetrical curve exhibiting a smooth concave sweep from the median notch extending to upward-tilted distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Widespread spatial detection of roughly circular white rings (diameter range 5-15 pixels) clustered densely across the mid-section and trailing regions of both lobes, indicative of barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear white pixel disruptions visible on the mid-section of the left lobe (ventral view) and near the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring (rosettes) across the ventral surface and significant jagged irregular tissue loss or irregular growth at the extreme distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular and granular texture at the distal tips of the fluke, distinct from the smoother serration along the central trailing edge.
